name: Rongo Belov-Ntim
role: Network intrusion and digital warfare specialist — netrunner
location: Dockside — Lake Michigan waterfront, smuggler territory
description:
Rongo Belov-Ntim is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 46, he has the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would  — and he makes no effort to hide it.

His entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. He works as a netrunner out of Dockside, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Rongo Belov-Ntim is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who he burned last.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
core_desires: To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
psychology.secret: Rongo Belov-Ntim is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Repeats the last thing someone said back to them before responding — processing or intimidation
example_lines: "Every system has a door. Most of them have a door the architect forgot about."
"I don't hack networks. I have conversations with them. Most of them are lonely."
"The ice they're running is military-grade. That means expensive, not impenetrable."

story_hooks: A crew member from Rongo Belov-Ntim's past shows up in Meridian 88, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A Tier 4 executive offers Rongo Belov-Ntim a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Rongo Belov-Ntim discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
narrative_function: As a netrunner, Rongo Belov-Ntim embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would incapacitate. Bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striking power
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
